MASTER SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT

This Master Software Development Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of January 1, 2024,
between Acme Corp, a Delaware corporation ("Company"), and Client Inc., a California corporation ("Client").

1. SERVICES
1.1 The Company shall provide software development services ("Services") as described in each
Statement of Work ("SOW") executed by both parties.
1.2 Company shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with
industry standards.

2. PAYMENT
2.1 Client shall pay all invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.
2.2 Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month,
or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is less.
2.3 Client shall reimburse Company for all pre-approved expenses.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
3.1 All work product, inventions, and deliverables created by Company under this Agreement shall
be considered works made for hire and shall be the sole and exclusive property of Client.
3.2 Company hereby irrevocably assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in and to
all Deliverables, including all intellectual property rights therein, in perpetuity throughout
the universe, without any compensation beyond the fees set forth herein.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
4.1 Each party agrees to keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party.
4.2 These obligations shall survive termination of this Agreement indefinitely.

5. INDEMNIFICATION
5.1 Client shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Company and its affiliates, officers,
directors, employees, agents, and successors from and against any and all claims, damages,
losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of
or relating to: (a) Client's use of the Services or Deliverables; (b) any breach by Client of
this Agreement; (c) any negligence or willful misconduct by Client; or (d) any third-party claims
related to Client's business operations.

6. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
6.1 IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL,
EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOST PROFITS, HOWEVER CAUSED AND UNDER
ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY.
6.2 COMPANY'S TOTAL CUMULATIVE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT
EXCEED THE AMOUNTS PAID BY CLIENT TO COMPANY IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

7. TERMINATION
7.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice.
7.2 Company may terminate immediately upon Client's material breach.
7.3 Upon termination, all licenses granted herein shall immediately terminate.

8. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
8.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to
conflict of law principles.
8.2 Any dispute shall be resolved by binding arbitration in Wilmington, Delaware under the rules
of the American Arbitration Association.

9. ASSIGNMENT
9.1 Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party,
except that Company may assign to an affiliate or successor.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
